text: Check for beta updates and read release history from Settings. Every signed-in Noted account can join the beta.
Receive quiet update reminders and open signed Android updates in your browser. Finish installation using Android's installer.
Update prompts wait until notes, recording, App Lock and sensitive screens are closed. Your saved notes and pending offline edits stay in place.
Improved workspace filtering, shared-note previews, image placement, connection refresh and delete/undo ordering.
